1.consolidated_definition: Loción de cabello. Líquido o crema que suaviza y puede dar cuerpo al cabello. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. La solución es darle un corte que le reste peso, o cortarlo en capas y darle un permanente de ondas suaves; con esto podrían hacerse rolos y aplicando setting lotion, darle cuerpo (El Nuevo Día, 06-01-99)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Hairstyling treatment. A liquid or cream that softens and can add body to the hair. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. The solution is to give it a cut that reduces weight, or cut it in layers and apply a permanent wave with soft waves; this way, rolls could be made and applying setting lotion, body could be given (The New Day, 06-01-99)
